What end of life means

Drupal 7 reached its end of life on 5 January 2025. Since then, security problems found in Drupal 7 core get no fix from the Drupal Security Team, and contributed modules no longer have to support it.Source: Drupal's end-of-life policy, with the date above

What a migration involves

Drupal 7 cannot be updated in place to a supported version. Moving to Drupal 10 or 11 is a migration: a new site is built on current Drupal, and the content, users and files are carried across with Drupal's own migration tools.

Custom modules and the theme are rebuilt for the new version, and each contributed module is matched to its current release or a replacement. The old site stays live until the new one has been checked, so the switch can be planned for a quiet day.
